scope: Standalone additive schema candidate for SQLite/D1. NOT deployed to Cloudflare or used with private/signed science.
demonstrated_local_properties: One competing duplicate original ID insert wins under concurrent local SQLite connections
Strict per-lane source sequence increment and prior-receipt SHA chain
Reject duplicate first use, sequence gaps, stale source, wrong prior digest and identical signer-key digests
Append-only trigger denies SQL UPDATE/DELETE and lane allowlist rejects CKB/KTRADE
Windows file handles closed before ephemeral cleanup
limitations: SQLite local concurrency is not live Cloudflare D1 CAS qualification
Database with privileged write access can alter/drop schema; no operational immutable custodian verified
SQL stores claimed signer digests but does not independently validate original Ed25519 signatures
No existing D1 binding attached, migrated or modified
No independent source-birth actor, out-of-band key pin, physical independent witness or high-water receipt
No original scientific source born, consumed or executed
